description: Serves the NO_MATCHING_ALTERNATIVE reason, which the clause needs in order to tell the two causeless reasons apart from the one that carries a cause. Both entries are alternatives-only roots with no default translation, which LocalizedStringLoader permits when at least one alternative is present (the shape the existing gender-multi-axis-alternatives-only fixture already proves loadable), so a miss returns Optional.empty from getInternal and DefaultStrings.java:719-720 records NO_MATCHING_ALTERNATIVE with no throwable. The second entry's KEY is itself a placeholder template and is PRESENT in the catalog, so the returned-key path can be observed under a reason other than MISSING_TRANSLATION. One loaded locale, so tiebreakers are null.

Guest.Welcome.commentary: Alternatives-only root: a masculine guest matches nothing and there is no default translation.

Hello {{name}}.commentary: A key that is itself a template AND exists in the catalog, so a miss is NO_MATCHING_ALTERNATIVE rather than MISSING_TRANSLATION while the returned key still interpolates.
